## Today's theme
Live search came back thin on a single breakout — the results are mostly evergreen "best memecoin" listicles. The one signal that repeats as a *current* rotation is **dog-themed memes** (WIF explicitly flagged "on this list right now," alongside DOGE/SHIB). That's the hot archetype today, so I'll ride it with a fresh twist rather than a tired clone. Treat this as the current rotation read, not a guaranteed catalyst — memecoin themes turn over fast.

## Cost breakdown

**EventTrader Launchpad — Robinhood Chain (our own rail, non-custodial):**
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Creation fee | **$0** |
| Gas | Chain gas only — ETH **on Robinhood Chain (4663)**, ~0.0013 ETH for a ~3M-gas launch; fund ~0.003 ETH to be safe |
| Optional dev-buy | Whatever ETH you choose (capped at 2% of supply by the 40-block anti-snipe guard) |
| Creator earnings | **80% of the 0.25% trade fee, forever** |

**pump.fun — Solana (classic memecoin rail, custodial, no wallet needed):**
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Platform fee | **$5.00 USDC** (from your balance) |
| Gas | ~$2 — **paid by the platform**, no SOL needed |
| Creator earnings | 1% swap fee |

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The two rails differ in *who holds the keys*. Robinhood Chain is **non-custodial** — `launch_create_token` would return an unsigned tx you sign with your own wallet, so I can never spend from here; but it needs ETH *on chain 4663*, which your 0.062 ETH is not (that's mainnet/other). pump.fun is **custodial** — a flat $5 USDC debit from your $171.68 balance, platform signs and pays gas, so it's the zero-setup path. Your wallet state is the deciding factor, not the theme.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

**Stopping here — nothing spent, no token created.** Say the word to launch and I'll walk the signing (Robinhood) or debit the $5 (pump.fun). Want a marketing kit lined up too? A memecoin with no distribution is dead on arrival.

I'll work through this properly: verify which of the four I can actually buy, compare their real 30-day flow, then execute. Let me load the tools I need and pull live data — starting with CARDS as you asked.Here's what the live data says. I pulled 30-day MACD (hourly, ~720 data points each) for all four and checked each against the actual buy rails — starting with CARDS.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- **"30-day flow" is best read from the MACD histogram normalized by price**, not the raw number — a $0.0003 histogram on a $0.14 coin (KNC, ~0.2%) is a much weaker impulse than $0.0029 on a $0.25 coin (CARDS, ~1.2%).
- **"Can actually buy" is a separate, harder gate than "is listed."** All four show `clone_tradeable: true` in the catalog, but that only means a *bot* can route them via best-execution — it does **not** mean there's a direct spot/swap rail for a user. I verified the actual swap route and it rejected all of them.
- **Missing price data is itself a signal here**: MNDE returned *no price history from any source* and SOLV printed `$0.00` — on this platform those are Solana-native / thinly-routed names, so "no clean flow" and "no clean buy" coincide.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

## The comparison

| Token | 30-day MACD trend | Histogram | ~% of price | Price | Data |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CARDS** (Collector Crypt) | **bullish** | **+0.0029** | **~1.2%** | $0.25 | 721 pts ✅ |
| KNC (Kyber) | bullish | +0.0003 | ~0.2% | $0.14 | 720 pts |
| SOLV (Solv Protocol) | bearish | ~0.0 | — | $0.00 ⚠️ | no usable price |
| MNDE (Marinade) | — | — | — | — | ❌ no history |

**The pick is CARDS** — it has by far the strongest 30-day flow (3 lines):
1. **Only clean, healthy uptrend in the set** — MACD 0.0131 sits above its signal 0.0102 with a +0.0029 histogram (~1.2% of a $0.25 price) across a full 721-point series.
2. **The rest disqualify themselves on flow or data** — SOLV is bearish and prints $0, MNDE has no price history anywhere (Solana-native, KuCoin-delisted), KNC is only *marginally* bullish (~0.2%).
3. So on momentum, CARDS wins outright.

## But the honest blocker on "actually buy"

I tried to place the $100 paper buy and **I can't fill it as a direct spot purchase** — the swap/buy route returned *"I don't have CARDS listed"* on **both Ethereum and Solana** (and KNC/SOLV failed the same way on Ethereum). None of the four is a CLOB pair or in the direct-buy registry here, so there is no single-asset $100 spot paper-buy rail for them. I'm not going to fabricate a fill that didn't happen.

What *is* real for getting long CARDS in paper on this platform:
- **Cloned-bot catalog trading** — I set up a paper clone with `catalog_watchlist="CARDS"`; it trades CARDS long via best-execution in simulation (the bot sizes entries itself, not a clean one-shot $100).
- **Paper event card** — CARDS can be a basket leg (cards need 3–12 legs, so it'd ride alongside 2+ others), then paper-trade it UP.

Want me to set up the bot-catalog paper route on CARDS, or build a small paper event card around it? I'll execute whichever immediately.
